output.subject: Your question about settling your former credit card account
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch, and for taking this step. We appreciate you reaching out to resolve this.

You told us that your old credit card with us was charged off in 2023, and that you are now in a position to settle it. You asked two things: who you should speak with about a settlement, and whether you can get the settlement terms in writing before you make any payment.

We have passed your message to our Collections & Recoveries team, who will review your account and your questions. They will respond to you within 10 business days with an answer on who to contact and on your request to have the terms in writing before paying.

In the meantime, if anything about your circumstances changes or you have further questions, please reply to this message and we will add it to your file.

Thank you again for reaching out. We look forward to helping you with the next steps.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Inquiry, not a complaint: customer wants to settle a credit card charged off in 2023.
Confirm the bank still owns the debt or whether it was sold or placed with a third-party collector; if so, tell the customer who to contact.
Decide whether written settlement terms can be provided before payment and say so explicitly in the reply.
Add the correct contact point and method for Collections & Recoveries.
Do not confirm any settlement amount or credit-reporting outcome until Collections has reviewed the account.
